correctness.rationale: For each odd n≥5, the exact irredundant facet normals are Z_i=−e_i, E_i=e_i+e_{i+1} and H=(1,…,1) with odd-hole sum bound (n−1)/2. The odd edge relaxation has unique fractional all-half vertex, clipped by H; maximum stable sets on H form an (n−1)-simplex since their circulant incidence eigenvalues do not vanish. Every facet pair is explicitly classified: Z-Z and nonincident Z-E form right ridges; E-E neighboring and H-E form two obtuse families; disjoint E-E form right ridges for odd n≥7 but not n5; H-Z and incident Z-E do not form ridges. Outward Gram cosines 0,1/2,sqrt(2/n) yield angles pi/2,2pi/3,pi-acos(sqrt(2/n)). Multiplicities n5 (25,5,5), odd n≥7 (2n(n−2),n,n), and maximum changes n7/n9. Independent exact rational rank checks of every facet-pair intersection on n5,7,9 from all stable-set vertices reproduce counts 35,84,144; finite checks only corroborate all-n proof.
